Goal: To investigate the transdifferentiation population in various bulk datasets from CLL, Richter’s transformation (RT) and other conditions, with a view to linking this population to clinical data. To investigate using bulk data from PBMCs as well as lymph nodes.

```{r}
#| message: false
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggpubr)
library(splines)
library(starTracer)
devtools::load_all("/home/a.blanc-boekholt/Documents/Singlecell-R/multideconv")
#source("functions.R")

# CITE seq data patients 2 and 3 merged --> for the Intermediate population signatures 
data_cite<-readRDS(params$Data_CITEseq)
#data_cite<-subset(data_cite, subset = Annotation != "Erythroblast")
data_cite$Annotation<-ifelse(data_cite$Annotation %in% c("B intermediate", "B naive", "B memory", "B"), "B cells", data_cite$Annotation)
data_cite$Annotation<-ifelse(data_cite$Annotation %in% c("CD4 T", "CD8 T", "T"), "T cells", data_cite$Annotation)
data_cite$sample_time <- paste(data_cite$patient, data_cite$timepoint, sep = "_")
```

## 1) Create custom signatures based on the CITE-seq data (Patients 2 and 3) for the "intermediate population".

Metacells

```{r}
data_cite <- subset(data_cite, subset = Annotation %in% c("B intermediate","B naive", "B memory","CD4 T","CD8 T","NK","Neutrophil","Monocyte","Erythroblast","Macrophage","Bridge"))
# Create metacells because ~110k cells 
metacells = create_metacells(data_cite,
                             labels_column = "Annotation", 
                             samples_column = "sample_time", 
                             exclude_cells = NULL,
                             min_cells = 50, 
                             k = 15, 
                             max_shared = 15, 
                             n_workers = 1, 
                             min_meta = 10)

metacells_seurat = Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(metacells[["Counts"]], meta.data = metacells[["Metadata"]])
metacells_seurat <- NormalizeData(metacells_seurat, normalization.method = "LogNormalize")
```

Markers Seurat (wilcoxon test)

```{r}
# Calculate the top markers
Idents(data_cite) <- "Annotation"
markers <- FindAllMarkers(data_cite, assay = "RNA", slot = "data", only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.8, max.cells.per.ident = 1000)
# Filter significant markers
top_markers <- markers[markers$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]
# Split marker genes by cluster
top_markers_list <- split(top_markers$gene, top_markers$cluster)

# Evaluate/Checking specificity of the signatures 
fc_col <- intersect(c("avg_log2FC", "logFC", "avg_logFC"), names(top_markers))[1]

markers_scored <- top_markers %>%
  mutate(
    fc = .data[[fc_col]],
    specificity = (pct.1 - pct.2) * pmax(fc, 0),
    expr_diff = pct.1 - pct.2,
    support = pct.1 * fc,
    robust = ifelse(p_val_adj < 0.05 & pct.1 > 0.25, TRUE, FALSE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(specificity), desc(fc), desc(expr_diff))

best_markers <- markers_scored %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_head(n = 40) %>%
  ungroup()
# Split marker genes by cluster
top_markers_list <- split(best_markers$gene, best_markers$cluster)


DotPlot(object = data_cite,
    features = unique(best_markers$gene),
    group.by = "Annotation") +
  RotatedAxis()+labs(y = NULL, x = "Genes") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

markers_B <- FindMarkers(metacells_seurat, ident.1 = "Bridge" , ident.2 = "B cells" , assay = "RNA", slot = "data", only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.8, max.cells.per.ident = 1000)
markers_B <- markers_B[markers_B$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]
markers_B$diff<-markers_B$pct.1-markers_B$pct.2
markers_B_diff <- markers_B[markers_B$diff > 0.3, ]
markers_B_diff$gene<-rownames(markers_B_diff)


markers_macro <- FindMarkers(metacells_seurat, ident.1 = "Bridge" , ident.2 = "Macrophage" , assay = "RNA", slot = "data", only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.8, max.cells.per.ident = 1000)
markers_macro <- markers_macro[markers_macro$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]
markers_macro$diff<-markers_macro$pct.1-markers_macro$pct.2
markers_macro_diff <- markers_macro[markers_macro$diff > 0.3, ]
markers_macro_diff$gene<-rownames(markers_macro_diff)

# Intersect and union
inter<-intersect(markers_macro_diff$gene, markers_B_diff$gene)
union<-union(markers_macro_diff$gene, markers_B_diff$gene)
markers_test<-unique(best_markers$gene)
markers_test<-union(markers_test, union)
```

Markers selection (starTracer)

```{r}
DefaultAssay(data_cite) <- "RNA"
Idents(data_cite) <- data_cite$Annotation
data_cite <- subset(data_cite, subset = Annotation %in% c("B cells","T cells","NK","Neutrophil","Monocyte","DC","Macrophage","Bridge"))

data_cite <- FindVariableFeatures(data_cite, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

res <- searchMarker(
  x = data_cite, #the input seurat object
  thresh.1 = 0.5,
  thresh.2 = NULL,
  method = "pos", 
  num = 60,
  gene.use = NULL,
  meta.data = NULL,
  ident.use = Annotation)

markers<-res[["exprs.markers"]]
markers<-as.data.frame(markers)
markers_genes<-rownames(markers)

# Split marker genes by cluster
top_markers_df <- res$para_frame[res$para_frame$gene %in% res$genes.markers, ]
nrow(top_markers_df)
length(res$genes.markers)
# List by cluster
markers_gene <- split(as.character(top_markers_df$gene), top_markers_df$max.X)
str(markers_gene)
sapply(markers_gene, length)

# Plots
DotPlot(object = data_cite,
    features = markers_genes,
    group.by = "Annotation") +
  RotatedAxis()+labs(y = NULL, x = "Genes") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

DotPlot(object = metacells_seurat,
    features = markers_genes,
    group.by = "Annotation") +
  RotatedAxis()+labs(y = NULL, x = "Genes") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```

Signatures

```{r}
# Pseudobulk of my single-cell data
pseudobulk = create_sc_pseudobulk(metacells_seurat, cells_labels = "Annotation", sample_labels = "sample_time", normalized = TRUE, file_name = "Pseudobulk_deconvolution")

# Create a signature using Multideconv 
metacell_metadata<-metacells_seurat@meta.data
signatures = create_sc_signatures(metacells[["Counts"]], 
                                  metacell_metadata, 
                                  cells_labels = "Annotation", 
                                  sample_labels = "sample_time", 
                                  bulk_rna = pseudobulk, 
                                  cell_markers = markers_gene, 
                                  name_signature = "CITE_CLL_subset", 
                                  credentials.mail = "augustine.blanc-boekholt@inserm.fr", 
                                  credentials.token = "614b135494faade1a53c2ebc62b55829",
                                  methods_sig = c("BSeqsc"))

# Verify the signature
#1) deconvolution pseudobulk 
deconv_pseudo = compute.deconvolution(raw.counts = pseudobulk,
                               normalized = FALSE, methods = c("Epidish", "DeconRNASeq", "DWLS","CBSX"),
                               signatures_select = c("BSeqSC-CITE_CLL_subset-scRNAseq"),
                               return = TRUE, 
                               credentials.mail = "augustine.blanc-boekholt@inserm.fr",
                               credentials.token = "614b135494faade1a53c2ebc62b55829",
                               file_name = "pseudobulk")

#2) # Counting real cell proportion 
cells_groundtruth <- table(metacells_seurat$sample_time, metacells_seurat$Annotation)
cells_groundtruth <- prop.table(cells_groundtruth, margin = 1)
cells_groundtruth <- as.data.frame.matrix(cells_groundtruth)
colnames(cells_groundtruth) <- dplyr::recode(
  colnames(cells_groundtruth),
  "B cells" = "B.cells",
  "Macrophage" = "Macrophages.cells",
  "Monocyte" = "Monocytes",
  "Neutrophil" = "Neutrophils",
  "NK" = "NK.cells",
  "T cells" = "T.cells",
  "CD4 T" = "CD4.T",
  "CD8 T" = "CD8.T"
)

#3) Compute deconvolution benchmark
benchmark = compute.benchmark(deconv_pseudo, 
                              cells_groundtruth, 
                              corr_type = "pearson",
                              scatter = TRUE, 
                              plot = TRUE, 
                              pval = 0.05, 
                              file_name = "Deconvolution", 
                              width = 10, 
                              height = 5)
```

## 3) Deconvolution of CLL bulk dataset with custom signature

#### PBMC: Dataset CLL-map (Knisbacher, B. A., et al. 2022)

708 samples + clinical data

```{r}
# Bulk Data for the deconvolution 
data_bulk<-read.table(params$Data_bulk, header=T)
data_bulk<-data_bulk[,-1]
cols_to_remove <- c("CRC.0007","CRC.0011","CRC.0028", "CRC.0033", "DFCI.5053", "JB.0010", "GCLL.0136")
data_bulk <- data_bulk[, !colnames(data_bulk) %in% cols_to_remove]
data_bulk$variance <- apply(data_bulk[, -1], 1, var)
# keep gene with the higher variance
data_bulk <- data_bulk %>%
  group_by(Description) %>%
  slice_max(variance, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-variance)
data_bulk <-data.frame(data_bulk)
genes <- data_bulk$Description
data_bulk$Description <- NULL
rownames(data_bulk) <- genes
data_bulk[] <- lapply(data_bulk, as.numeric)
data_bulk <- as.matrix(data_bulk)

# Clinical data 
clinical<-read.table(params$Clinical, sep="\t", header=TRUE, fill = TRUE)
clinical$participant_id<-gsub("-", ".", clinical$participant_id)

id<-intersect(colnames(data_bulk),clinical$participant_id)

clinical<-subset(clinical, participant_id %in% id)
data_bulk <- data_bulk[, colnames(data_bulk) %in% id]
```

```{r}
# Deconvolution 
deconv_bulk = compute.deconvolution(raw.counts = data_bulk,
                               normalized = TRUE, 
                               methods = c("Epidish","DWLS", "CBSX"),
                               signatures_select = c("BSeqSC-CITE_CLL-scRNAseq"),
                               return = TRUE, credentials.mail = "marcelo.hurtado@inserm.fr",
                               credentials.token = "b72981d4d0554bcfffc37472ccd8588d",
                               file_name = "Deconvolution_bulk_CLL")

deconv_subgroups = compute.deconvolution.analysis(deconvolution = deconv_bulk,
                                                  corr = 0.7,
                                                  seed = 123,
                                                  file_name = "Bulk_CLL",
                                                  return = TRUE)

deconv_cite<-deconv_bulk[,colnames(deconv_bulk) %in% c("DWLS_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_Bridge","CBSX_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_Bridge", "Epidish_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_Bridge","DeconRNASeq_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_Bridge")]
correlation_bridge<-cor(deconv_cite,use = "complete.obs")
colnames(correlation_bridge)<-gsub("_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_", ".", colnames(correlation_bridge))
rownames(correlation_bridge)<-gsub("_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_", ".", rownames(correlation_bridge))
```

```{r}
# Heatmap proportion 
pheatmap(t(deconv_bulk), cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE, show_colnames = FALSE, annotation_col = annotation)
# Heatmap z-score proportion 
mat_z <- t(scale(t(deconv_bulk)))
pheatmap(t(mat_z), cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE, show_colnames = FALSE, annotation_col = annotation)


# Without B cells pop 
deconv_bcells<-deconv_bulk[, !colnames(deconv_bulk) %in% c("DWLS_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_B.cells","CBSX_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_B.cells", "Epidish_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_B.cells","DeconRNASeq_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_B.cells")]
# Heatmap z-score proportion 
mat_z <- t(scale(t(deconv_bcells)))
rownames(clinical) <- clinical$participant_id
annotation <- clinical[colnames(t(mat_z)), c("IGL_expression", "vital_status", "tumor_molecular_subtype", "cll_epitype","IGHV_mut","treatment_status_at_samp")]
pheatmap(t(mat_z), cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE, show_colnames = FALSE, annotation_col = annotation)


# Comparison clinical data 
# Fusion clinical data and deconv results 
deconv_bulk$participant_id<-rownames(deconv_bulk)
data<-merge(clinical, deconv_bulk, by="participant_id")
# Mean 3 deconv methods 
data$Bridge_mean<-rowMeans(data[, c("DWLS_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_Bridge","CBSX_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_Bridge", "Epidish_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_Bridge")])
  
# treated and untreated, alive and dead, mutation, rai (cancer stage)
comparisons <- list(c("Treated", "Untreated"))
plot<-ggplot(data, aes(x = treatment_status_at_samp, y = Bridge_mean)) + geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) + geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA) + stat_compare_means(comparisons = comparisons, method = "wilcox.test", size=6) + theme_classic() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size=16), axis.text.y=element_text(size = 14), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18), legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
legend.text = element_text(size = 18) ) + xlab("Treatment status") + ylab("Intermediate population deconvolution")
plot

# Survival curve
# Define OS_event, where status = 1 for death/event, 0 for censored 
data$OS_event <- ifelse(data$vital_status == "alive","0","1")

# Kaplan-Meirl curve (Are the survival curves for the two groups significantly different? test log-rank)
data$Bridge_group <- ifelse(data$Bridge_mean >= median(data$Bridge_mean),"High","Low")
data$Bridge_group <- ifelse(data$DWLS_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_Bridge >= median(data$DWLS_BSeqSC.CITE_CLL.scRNAseq_Bridge),"High","Low")

surv_obj <- Surv(time = data$os_days,event = data$os)
fit <- survfit(surv_obj ~ Bridge_group, data = data)
ggsurvplot(fit, data = data,
    pval = TRUE,
    risk.table = TRUE,
    conf.int = TRUE,
    palette = c("#2E9FDF", "#E7B800"))

# Cox model (Is the proportion of Intermediate population associated with the risk of death?)
cox <- coxph(Surv(os_days, os) ~ Bridge_mean, data = data)
summary(cox)
ggforest(cox, data = data)
cox.zph(cox)
plot(cox.zph(cox))

cox_spline <- coxph(
  Surv(os_days, os) ~ ns(Bridge_mean, df = 3),
  data = data)
```

```{r}
data2$Bridge_group <- ifelse(data2$Bridge_mean >= median(data2$Bridge_mean),"High","Low")

data2$death_days_from_samp<-as.numeric(data2$death_days_from_samp)
data2$OS_event<-as.numeric(data2$OS_event)
surv_obj <- Surv(time = data2$os_days,event = data2$os)
fit <- survfit(surv_obj ~ Bridge_group, data = data2)
ggsurvplot(fit, data = data2,
    pval = TRUE,
    risk.table = TRUE,
    conf.int = TRUE,
    palette = c("#2E9FDF", "#E7B800"))


q <- quantile(data$Bridge_mean, c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE)

data2 <- subset(
  data,
  Bridge_mean <= q[1] | Bridge_mean >= q[2]
)

data2$Bridge_group <- ifelse(
  data2$Bridge_mean <= q[1],
  "Low",
  "High"
)

fit <- survfit(Surv(os_days, os) ~ Bridge_group, data = data2)

ggsurvplot(
  fit,
  data = data2,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  pval = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
)
```

#### Deconvolution LN CD19+

After STAR (FastQ –\> Count matrix)

```{r}
# COUNT MATRIX
library(GenomicFeatures)   # BiocManager::install("GenomicFeatures")
library(rtracklayer)
library(txdbmaker)

# Gene lentgh GTF
txdb <- makeTxDbFromGFF("/home/a.blanc-boekholt/Documents/Singlecell-R/Scripts/Data/Dataset CLL lymph node (Sun C, et al., 2023)/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.116.gtf", format = "gtf")
exons_by_gene <- exonsBy(txdb, by = "gene")
gene_len <- sum(width(reduce(exons_by_gene)))   # reduce() = fusion exons
gene_len <- vapply(
  exons_by_gene,
  function(x) sum(width(reduce(x))),
  numeric(1))

# Count matrix
counts <- read.table("/home/a.blanc-boekholt/Documents/Singlecell-R/Scripts/Data/Dataset CLL lymph node (Sun C, et al., 2023)/count_matrix.txt", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)

# Align
common <- intersect(rownames(counts), names(gene_len))
cat(length(common), "genes out", nrow(counts), "found in the GTF\n")
counts <- counts[common, ]
len<- gene_len[common]

# TPM
library(scuttle)
tpm_matrix <- calculateTPM(counts, lengths = len)
colSums(tpm_matrix)

# Ensembl ID to gene name 
gtf <- import("/home/a.blanc-boekholt/Documents/Singlecell-R/Scripts/Data/Dataset CLL lymph node (Sun C, et al., 2023)/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.116.gtf")
genes <- as.data.frame(gtf[gtf$type == "gene"])
annot <- unique(genes[, c("gene_id", "gene_name", "gene_biotype")])
# Keep only protein coding gene 
library(dplyr)
annot<-subset(annot, gene_biotype == 'protein_coding')
annot<- annot %>% filter(!is.na(gene_name))
tpm_matrix<-data.frame(tpm_matrix)
tpm_matrix$Genes<-rownames(tpm_matrix)
tpm_filt<-merge(tpm_matrix, annot, by.x='Genes', by.y='gene_id')

# Remove duplicated gene names 
sum(duplicated(tpm_filt$gene_name))
tpm_filt <- aggregate(
  tpm_filt[, -which(names(tpm_filt) == "gene_name")],
  by = list(gene = tpm_filt$gene_name),
  FUN = max)

tpm_filt <- tpm_filt[, !names(tpm_filt) %in% c("Genes", "gene_biotype")]

# Add sample name and not the SRR name
samples <- read.table("/home/a.blanc-boekholt/Documents/Singlecell-R/Scripts/Data/Dataset CLL lymph node (Sun C, et al., 2023)/SraRunTable.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",", check.names = FALSE)
samples_name <- read.table("/home/a.blanc-boekholt/Documents/Singlecell-R/Scripts/Data/Dataset CLL lymph node (Sun C, et al., 2023)/Sample_name.txt", header = F, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)
colnames(samples_name) <-c("Sample Name", "Samples")
library(stringr)
samples_name$`Sample Name` <- str_trim(samples_name$`Sample Name`, side = "right")
samples <- merge(samples, samples_name, by="Sample Name")
library(dplyr)
dict_name <- setNames(samples$Samples, samples$Run)
tpm_filt <- tpm_filt %>%
  rename_with(~ ifelse(.x %in% names(dict_name), dict_name[.x], .x))

write.table(tpm_filt, "/home/a.blanc-boekholt/Documents/Singlecell-R/Scripts/Data/Dataset CLL lymph node (Sun C, et al., 2023)/count_tpm_filt.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = T, row.names=F)
```

## Correlation between CEBPa activity and Bridge proportion deconvolution

```{r}
# Infer TFs activity using the CLL network
library(viper)
data_log<-log2(tpm_filt+1)
data_log <- as.matrix(data_log)
regulon<-readRDS("/home/a.blanc-boekholt/Documents/NetREM/regulon_grn_CLL.rds")
tf_aracne <- viper(data_log, regulon, method = "none", minsize = 5)

# Correlation 
cebpa <- tf_aracne["CEBPA", , drop = FALSE] %>%
    t() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
    mutate(Sample = gsub("-", ".", Sample))

bridge <- deconv_bulk %>%
    rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
    select(Sample, ends_with(".Bridge")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Sample, names_to = "Method", values_to = "Bridge") %>%
    mutate(Method = sub("\\.Bridge$", "", Method))

df <- inner_join(cebpa, bridge, by = "Sample") %>%
    mutate(Patient = sub("_.*", "", Sample),Sample_type = factor(str_extract(Sample, "PB|LN"), levels = c("PB", "LN")))
nrow(df)

# Scatter plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = CEBPA, y = Bridge, color = Sample_type)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15) +
    stat_cor(data = filter(df, Sample_type == "PB"), method = "pearson", cor.coef.name = "R", size = 3.3,
           label.x.npc = 1, label.y.npc = 0.12, hjust = 1) +
  stat_cor(data = filter(df, Sample_type == "LN"),method = "pearson", cor.coef.name = "R", size = 3.3,
           label.x.npc = 1, label.y.npc = 0.02, hjust = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("PB" = "lightblue3", "LN" = "darkblue")) + facet_wrap(~ Method, scales = "free_y") +labs(title="CEBPa activity and Intermediate population proportion correlation (Pearson)",x = "CEBPa activity", y = "Proportion Intermediate population",color = "Sample type") +
    theme_minimal()

# correlation values
cors <- df %>%
    group_by(Method, Sample_type) %>%
    summarise(R = cor(CEBPA, Bridge, method = "pearson"),
              p   = cor.test(CEBPA, Bridge, method = "pearson", exact = FALSE)$p.value,
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))
cors


# Fusion all deconv methods (mean)
library(tidyverse)
df_cons <- df %>%
    group_by(Method) %>%
    mutate(Bridge_z = as.numeric(scale(Bridge))) %>%
    group_by(Sample, Patient, Sample_type, CEBPA) %>%
    summarise(Bridge_consensus = mean(Bridge_z), .groups = "drop")
# Pearson
cors <- df_cons %>%
    group_by(Sample_type) %>%
    summarise(R = cor(CEBPA, Bridge_consensus, method = "pearson"),
              p   = cor.test(CEBPA, Bridge_consensus, method = "pearson", exact = FALSE)$p.value,
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(Sample_type, ": R = ", round(R, 2), ", p = ", signif(p, 2)),
           vjust = ifelse(Sample_type == "LN", -0.5, -2))

ggplot(df_cons, aes(x = CEBPA, y = Bridge_consensus, color = Sample_type)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_text(data = cors,aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = label, vjust = vjust, color = Sample_type),
              hjust = 1.05, size = 3.5, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("PB" = "lightblue3", "LN" = "darkblue")) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.2, 0.05))) +
    labs(x = "CEBPA activity",y = "Intermediate population (consensus z-score, 4 methods)",color = "Sample type") +theme_minimal()
```

## Enrichment with AUCell

```{r}
DefaultAssay(data_cite) <- "RNA"
Idents(data_cite) <- data_cite$Annotation
data_cite <- subset(data_cite, subset = Annotation %in% c("B cells","T cells","NK","Neutrophil","Monocyte","Erythroblast","Macrophage","Bridge"))
```

Seurat

```{r}
# Calculate the top markers
Idents(data_cite) <- "Annotation"
markers <- FindAllMarkers(data_cite, assay = "RNA", slot = "data", only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.8, max.cells.per.ident = 1000)
# Filter significant markers
top_markers <- markers[markers$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]
# Split marker genes by cluster
top_markers_list <- split(top_markers$gene, top_markers$cluster)

# Evaluate/Checking specificity of the signatures 
fc_col <- intersect(c("avg_log2FC", "logFC", "avg_logFC"), names(top_markers))[1]

markers_scored <- top_markers %>%
  mutate(
    fc = .data[[fc_col]],
    specificity = (pct.1 - pct.2) * pmax(fc, 0),
    expr_diff = pct.1 - pct.2,
    support = pct.1 * fc,
    robust = ifelse(p_val_adj < 0.05 & pct.1 > 0.25, TRUE, FALSE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(specificity), desc(fc), desc(expr_diff))

best_markers <- markers_scored %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_head(n = 40) %>%
  ungroup()
# Split marker genes by cluster
top_markers_list <- split(best_markers$gene, best_markers$cluster)


DotPlot(object = data_cite,
    features = unique(best_markers$gene),
    group.by = "Annotation") +
  RotatedAxis()+labs(y = NULL, x = "Genes") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```

```{r}
geneSets<-top_markers_list[["Bridge"]]
counts <- GetAssayData(data_cite, slot = "counts")
cells_rankings <- AUCell_buildRankings(
  counts, plotStats = FALSE)
cells_AUC <- AUCell_calcAUC(geneSets, cells_rankings)

png("~/Documents/Singlecell-R/Scripts/Plots/thresholds_cite.png", width = 1200, height = 1000)

# Add the signature activity in teh seurat object

axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16) ) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.01, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.5) +
  xlab("Cell type") + ylab("AUC (signature transdifferenciation)")
plot
```

# Deconvolution MeDuSA

Trajectory with slinghot

```{r}
library(MeDuSA)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(slingshot)
library(ggplot2)
library(harmony)
source("functions.R")

# Trajectory with Slingshot

data = readRDS("~/Documents/Singlecell-R/Scripts/Matrix/CLL_Seurat_P2P3.rds")
Idents(data) <- data$Annotation

#Pseudotime Slinghsot
# Remove clusters that are not connect to the main trajectory.    
scdata = data[,!Idents(data) %in% c('CD8 T','CD4 T','T','NK','DC','Neutrophil','Platelet','Erythroblast','Monocyte')] # Monocytes ??
scdata$sample_time <- paste(scdata$patient, scdata$timepoint, sep = "_")
#remove(data)
scdata <- run_dim_red(scdata)
scdata <- scdata %>%
  RunUMAP(reduction = "harmony",  dims = 1:15)

# Annotate cell trajectory using the slingshot
umap = as.data.frame(Embeddings(scdata,'umap'))
scdata$celltype_time <- paste(scdata$Annotation, scdata$timepoint, sep = "_")
Idents(scdata) <- scdata$celltype_time
umap$ct = as.vector(Idents(scdata))

#scdata <-FindClusters(scdata,resolution = 2)
sds = getLineages(umap[,1:2], umap$ct, start.clus = 'B intermediate_D1', end.clus = 'Macrophage_D14') # or D1 B naive ?? # faire un clustring et utiliser le numero du cluster
#sds = getLineages(umap[,1:2], umap$ct, end.clus = 'Macrophage') # or D1 B naive ?? # faire un clustring et utiliser le numero du cluster
sds = getCurves(sds)
path = as.data.frame(sds@metadata$curves$Lineage1$s)
pseudo_time = sds@metadata$curves$Lineage1$lambda
pseudo_time = pseudo_time/max(pseudo_time)

# Add the cell-type and cell-state trajectory into the meta data. 
scdata$cell_type = scdata$Annotation
scdata$cell_trajectory = pseudo_time[colnames(scdata)]

# Visualize the cell-state trajectory
colors = c("#9e0142", "#d53e4f", "#f46d43", "#fdae61", "#fee08b", "#ffffbf", "#e6f598", "#abdda4", "#66c2a5", "#3288bd", "#5e4fa2")
colors = colors[seq(length(colors),1,-1)]
p1 = ggplot(umap,aes(x=umap_1,y=umap_2))+
  geom_point(aes(col=pseudo_time),size=0.5)+
  xlab('PATH-1')+
  ylab('PATH-2')+
  theme(legend.position = 'right',
        legend.justification = "left",
        panel.border = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(size = 0.8))+
  #annotate('text',x=-2,y=-9,label='GMPs',size=5)+
  scale_color_gradientn(colours = colors,name='Pseudotime',labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1))
p1
ggsave("/home/ablanc/work/NetBIO2/Trajcetory/trjactory_slingshot.jpeg", p1, width = 1500, height = 2000, units = "px")
```

```{r}
# Estimate cell-state abundance from the scRNA-seq data 
pseudotime = scdata$cell_trajectory
sampleID = scdata$sample_time
pseudotime = pseudotime[names(sampleID)]
abundance_expect = sapply(unique(sampleID),function(id){
  pseudotime_temp = sort(pseudotime[which(sampleID == id)])
  pseudotime_temp = pseudotime_temp
  count_temp = hist(pseudotime_temp,breaks = seq(0,1,(1/40)))$counts
  abundance_temp  =  count_temp/sum(count_temp)
  return(abundance_temp)
})
rownames(abundance_expect) = paste0('bin',seq(1,nrow(abundance_expect)))
abundance_expect = abundance_expect[, colnames(abundance_expect) %in% colnames(bulk)]

# Compare the cell-state abundance estimated from bulk data to that from scRNA-seq data
abundance_estimate = MeDuSA_obj@Estimation$cell_state_abundance
state = MeDuSA_obj@Estimation$TimeBin
rownames(abundance_estimate) = state
rownames(abundance_expect) = state

commonId = intersect(colnames(abundance_expect),colnames(abundance_estimate))
abundance_expect = abundance_expect[,commonId]
abundance_estimate = abundance_estimate[,commonId]
dat = data.frame('MeDuSA' = c(abundance_estimate),'Slingshot' = c(abundance_expect))
p2 = ggplot(dat,aes(x=Slingshot,y=MeDuSA))+
  geom_point(col='#feb24c')+
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm',col='black',se=F)+
  xlab('scRNA-seq (slingshot)')
ylab('MeDuSA')
print(p2)

cor_global <- cor(dat$Slingshot,dat$MeDuSA,method = "spearman")
cor_global
```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggplot2)

# CEBPA and PAX5 extraction
tf_sub <- data.frame(
    sample_id = colnames(tf_activity),
    CEBPA     = as.numeric(tf_activity["CEBPA", ]),
    PAX5      = as.numeric(tf_activity["PAX5", ])
)

# Clinical data
clin <- read.delim(
    "~/Documents/Singlecell-R/Scripts/Data/Dataset CLL-map (Knisbacher, B. A., et al. 2022)/participants.tsv", 
    header = TRUE, 
    sep = "\t", 
    quote = "", 
    comment.char = "", 
    fill = TRUE, 
    check.names = FALSE, 
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, 
    na.strings = c("", "NA", "N/A")
)

clin$participant_id <- gsub("-", ".", clin$participant_id)

# Data merging
data <- merge(clin, tf_sub, by.x = "participant_id", by.y = "sample_id")

data$OS_event <- ifelse(data$vital_status == "alive", 0, 1)
data$os_days  <- as.numeric(data$os_days)

# filtering NA
data_clean <- data[!is.na(data$os_days) & !is.na(data$OS_event) & !is.na(data$CEBPA) & !is.na(data$PAX5), ]

# Transdifferenciation score(CEBPA High & PAX5 Low)
med_cebpa <- median(data_clean$CEBPA, na.rm = TRUE)
med_pax5  <- median(data_clean$PAX5, na.rm = TRUE)

data_clean$transdiff_score <- ifelse(
    data_clean$CEBPA > med_cebpa & data_clean$PAX5 < med_pax5, 
    "Transdifferentiated (CEBPA High / PAX5 Low)", 
    "Classic B-cell"
)

data_clean$transdiff_score <- factor(
    data_clean$transdiff_score, 
    levels = c("Classic B-cell", "Transdifferentiated (CEBPA High / PAX5 Low)")
)

table(data_clean$transdiff_score)

#Kaplan-Meier
fit_trans <- survfit(Surv(os_days, OS_event) ~ transdiff_score, data = data_clean)

# Plot
ggsurvplot(
    fit_trans, 
    data = data_clean, 
    pval = TRUE,
    risk.table = TRUE,
    legend.title = "Cellular Profile",
    legend.labs = c("CEBPA down + PAX5 up", "CEBPA up + PAX5 down"),
    palette = c("#2E9FDF", "#E7B800"),
    xlab = "Time (days)",
    title = "Impact of PAX5 and CEBPA activity Profile on Overall Survival"
)

library(survival)

#TF activity index
data_clean$transdiff_index <- data_clean$CEBPA - data_clean$PAX5

# Cox model with Spline 
fit_cox <- coxph(
  Surv(os_days, OS_event) ~ pspline(transdiff_index, df = 4), 
  data = data_clean
)

# Log-Hazard
termplot(
  fit_cox, 
  se = TRUE, 
  col.term = "#D55E00", 
  col.se = "#2E9FDF", 
  xlab = "Transdifferentiation Index (CEBPA - PAX5)", 
  ylab = "Log Hazard Ratio"
)
abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "gray")
```

Signature StarTracer

```{r}
library(starTracer)
DefaultAssay(data) <- "RNA"
Idents(data) <- data$Annotation

data <- FindVariableFeatures(data, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

res <- searchMarker(
  x = data, #the input seurat object
  thresh.1 = 0.5,
  thresh.2 = NULL,
  method = "pos", 
  num = 100,
  gene.use = NULL,
  meta.data = NULL,
  ident.use = Annotation)

markers<-res[["exprs.markers"]]
markers<-as.data.frame(markers)
markers_genes<-rownames(markers)

# Split marker genes by cluster
top_markers_df <- res$para_frame[res$para_frame$gene %in% res$genes.markers, ]
nrow(top_markers_df)
length(res$genes.markers)
# List by cluster
markers_gene <- split(as.character(top_markers_df$gene), top_markers_df$max.X)
str(markers_gene)
sapply(markers_gene, length)

# Plots
DotPlot(object = data,
    features = markers_genes,
    group.by = "Annotation") +
  RotatedAxis()+labs(y = NULL, x = "Genes") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```

Custom signature multideconv

```{r}
data$sample_time <- paste(data$patient, data$timepoint, sep = "_")
# Create metacells because ~110k cells 
metacells = create_metacells(data,
                             labels_column = "Annotation", 
                             samples_column = "sample_time", 
                             exclude_cells = NULL,
                             min_cells = 50, 
                             k = 15, 
                             max_shared = 15, 
                             n_workers = 1, 
                             min_meta = 10)

metacells_seurat = Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(metacells[["Counts"]], meta.data = metacells[["Metadata"]])
metacells_seurat <- NormalizeData(metacells_seurat, normalization.method = "LogNormalize")
```

```{r}
# Paired plot
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

deconv_long$Sample_type <- factor(deconv_long$Sample_type, levels = c("LN", "PB"))
deconv_long$Patient <- factor(deconv_long$Patient)
pvals <- deconv_long %>%
  select(Patient, Sample_type, Method, Proportion) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample_type, values_from = Proportion) %>%
  group_by(Method) %>%
  summarise(p = wilcox.test(PB, LN, paired = TRUE)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("p = ", signif(p, 2)))

ggplot(deconv_long, aes(x = Sample_type, y = Proportion,group = Patient, color = Patient)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_text(data = pvals, aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = label),vjust = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Method, scales = "fixed") +
  labs(title = "Paired plot fraction of Intermediate population: LN vs PB (paired by patient)",
       x = "Sample type", y = "Fraction intermediate population") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
```
